categories.title: Direction and movement
categories.description: Arrows and chevrons that move through pages, steps, lists and sections.

categories.title: Actions
categories.description: Things a person does to content: add, remove, copy, upload, search and undo.

categories.title: Status and feedback
categories.description: The state of a message, a task or a case, always shown together with words.

categories.title: Interface controls
categories.description: Menus, settings, views, visibility and media controls in an interface.

categories.title: Text editing
categories.description: Formatting, lists, alignment, links and code in the rich text editor.

categories.title: Tables and data
categories.description: Tables, the table tools of the editor, and charts of figures.

categories.title: Documents and files
categories.description: Documents, forms, attachments, images, certificates and folders.

categories.title: Communication
categories.description: Email, phone, chat, notifications, news and sending a message.

categories.title: People and identity
categories.description: People, accounts, identification, signing in and verified identity.

categories.title: Time and date
categories.description: Dates, times, appointments, time limits and history.

categories.title: Maps and places
categories.description: Maps, places, routes, map navigation and public buildings.

categories.title: Money and payments
categories.description: Paying, invoices, receipts and benefits paid out.

categories.title: Care, health and education
categories.description: Welfare services: health care, social care, schools and work.

categories.title: Mobility and environment
categories.description: Transport, streets, waste, water, energy and nature.

categories.title: Safety, law and civic life
categories.description: Security, privacy, emergencies, law and elections.

categories.title: Leisure, culture and community
categories.description: Clubs, bookings, sports places, trails and culture that a municipality runs or funds.

categories.title: Language and access
categories.description: Language, accessibility, display settings, reading aloud and captions.

categories.title: Social media
categories.description: Marks of social networks, always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text.

icons.name: arrow-back
icons.meaning: Go back: an arrow with a shaft pointing to the inline start.

icons.name: arrow-forward
icons.meaning: Go on, start or continue: an arrow with a shaft pointing to the inline end.

icons.name: chevron-back
icons.meaning: Previous, towards the inline start: a chevron pointing back.

icons.name: chevron-down
icons.meaning: Open or show what is below: a chevron pointing down.

icons.name: chevron-forward
icons.meaning: Next, towards the inline end: a chevron pointing forward.

icons.name: chevron-up
icons.meaning: Close or show what is above: a chevron pointing up.

icons.name: collapse-all
icons.meaning: Close every section at once: two chevrons pointing towards each other.

icons.name: expand-all
icons.meaning: Open every section at once: two chevrons pointing away from each other.

icons.name: external
icons.meaning: Opens somewhere else: an arrow leaving an open frame at its inline-end top.

icons.name: first
icons.meaning: Go to the first page or item: a chevron pointing back against a bar.

icons.name: last
icons.meaning: Go to the last page or item: a chevron pointing forward against a bar.

icons.name: refresh
icons.meaning: Load again or try again: a circular arrow.

icons.name: add
icons.meaning: Add or add another: a plus.

icons.name: check
icons.meaning: Selected or completed: a check mark.

icons.name: close
icons.meaning: Close, dismiss or clear: two crossed diagonal strokes.

icons.name: copy
icons.meaning: Copy to the clipboard: two equal sheets, one in front of the other.

icons.name: cut
icons.meaning: Cut to the clipboard: open scissors.

icons.name: delete
icons.meaning: Delete for good: a waste bin with a lid and a handle.

icons.name: download
icons.meaning: Save a file to the device: an arrow going down into an open tray.

icons.name: edit
icons.meaning: Change something: a pencil at 45 degrees, tip down.

icons.name: paste
icons.meaning: Paste from the clipboard: a board with a clip over its top edge.

icons.name: print
icons.meaning: Print: a printer with a sheet coming out of it.

icons.name: redo
icons.meaning: Redo the change: a U-turn arrow with its head at the inline end.

icons.name: remove
icons.meaning: Remove one or decrease: a minus.

icons.name: search
icons.meaning: Search: a magnifying glass, its handle to the lower right.

icons.name: share
icons.meaning: Share with others: three small rings joined in a V by two lines.

icons.name: undo
icons.meaning: Undo the last change: a U-turn arrow with its head at the inline start.

icons.name: upload
icons.meaning: Send a file from the device: an arrow rising out of an open tray.

icons.name: attention
icons.meaning: Needs your action: an exclamation mark, glyph only with no container, always with words.
icons.label: icons.attention

icons.name: blocked
icons.meaning: Blocked or not allowed: a barrier, a bar on two posts, glyph only with no container, always with words.
icons.label: icons.blocked

icons.name: error
icons.meaning: Something is wrong: an octagon with a small cross.
icons.label: icons.error

icons.name: help
icons.meaning: Help and support: a lifebuoy ring with four bands, never a question mark; glyph only with no container (the ring is the object), always with words.
icons.label: icons.help

icons.name: spinner
icons.meaning: A three-quarter arc that crawls when the class kv-animate-spinner is added; glyph only, always with words.
icons.label: icons.spinner

icons.name: info
icons.meaning: Information, good to know: a rounded square with a dot over a stem.
icons.label: icons.info

icons.name: new
icons.meaning: New or recently added: a four-pointed sparkle, glyph only with no container, always with words.
icons.label: icons.new

icons.name: pending
icons.meaning: Waiting, not started yet: an hourglass, glyph only with no container, always with words.
icons.label: icons.pending

icons.name: success
icons.meaning: Success or done: a circle with a check mark.
icons.label: icons.success

icons.name: warning
icons.meaning: Take care: a triangle with an exclamation mark.
icons.label: icons.warning

icons.name: drag-handle
icons.meaning: Move by dragging: six large dots in two columns of three.

icons.name: eye
icons.meaning: Show a hidden value: an open eye.

icons.name: eye-off
icons.meaning: Hide a shown value: an open eye with a slash broken around the pupil.

icons.name: filter
icons.meaning: Filter the results: a funnel with its stem cut at 45 degrees.

icons.name: fullscreen
icons.meaning: Enter full screen: four corner marks at the square keyline.

icons.name: fullscreen-exit
icons.meaning: Leave full screen: four corner marks turned inwards.

icons.name: lock
icons.meaning: Locked or secure: a closed padlock.
icons.label: icons.lock

icons.name: menu
icons.meaning: Open the navigation menu: three equal horizontal lines.
icons.label: icons.menu

icons.name: more
icons.meaning: More actions or options: three large dots in a row.

icons.name: more-vertical
icons.meaning: More actions for one row: three large dots stacked.

icons.name: pause
icons.meaning: Pause playback: two upright bars.

icons.name: play
icons.meaning: Start or resume playback: a triangle pointing right, which follows the media, not the script.

icons.name: settings
icons.meaning: Settings: a gear with eight teeth around a hub.

icons.name: sort
icons.meaning: Sortable, not sorted yet: an up arrow and a down arrow side by side.

icons.name: stop
icons.meaning: Stop playback: a rounded square.

icons.name: unlock
icons.meaning: Unlocked: a padlock with its shackle open.
icons.label: icons.unlock

icons.name: view-grid
icons.meaning: Show as a grid: four rounded tiles, two by two.

icons.name: align-center
icons.meaning: Centre the text: four lines, long and short, centred.

icons.name: align-end
icons.meaning: Align the text to the end: four lines flush to the inline end.

icons.name: align-start
icons.meaning: Align the text to the start: four lines flush to the inline start.

icons.name: bold
icons.meaning: Make text bold: the letter B.

icons.name: bullet-list
icons.meaning: A bulleted list: three large dots at the inline start, each with a text line.

icons.name: checklist
icons.meaning: A list of tasks to tick: two rows, each a small check and a text line.

icons.name: clear-formatting
icons.meaning: Remove all formatting: a heavy bar (a formatted run) with a small cross.

icons.name: code
icons.meaning: Inline code: a pair of angle brackets.

icons.name: code-block
icons.meaning: A block of code: small angle brackets inside a landscape frame.

icons.name: heading-1
icons.meaning: A level 1 heading: the letter H followed by the numeral 1.

icons.name: heading-2
icons.meaning: A level 2 heading: the letter H followed by the numeral 2.

icons.name: heading-3
icons.meaning: A level 3 heading: the letter H followed by the numeral 3.

icons.name: heading-4
icons.meaning: A level 4 heading: the letter H followed by the numeral 4.

icons.name: heading-5
icons.meaning: A level 5 heading: the letter H followed by the numeral 5.

icons.name: heading-6
icons.meaning: A level 6 heading: the letter H followed by the numeral 6.

icons.name: highlight
icons.meaning: Highlight text: a highlighter pen at 45 degrees over a baseline.

icons.name: indent
icons.meaning: Increase the indent: four lines, the middle two moved in, a small chevron to the end.

icons.name: italic
icons.meaning: Make text italic: the letter I with serifs, leaning forward.

icons.name: justify
icons.meaning: Justify the text: four equal full-width lines.

icons.name: link
icons.meaning: A link: two chain links on the 45 degree axis.

icons.name: link-off
icons.meaning: Remove a link: the outer halves of two chain links, parted by a slash.

icons.name: numbered-list
icons.meaning: A numbered list: rows marked with one, two and three tally ticks.

icons.name: outdent
icons.meaning: Decrease the indent: as indent, the chevron pointing to the inline start.

icons.name: quote
icons.meaning: A quotation block: a bar at the inline start beside three text lines.

icons.name: strike
icons.meaning: Strike text through: the letter S with a rule through it.

icons.name: text-color
icons.meaning: Change the colour of text: an ink drop over a baseline.

icons.name: underline
icons.meaning: Underline text: the letter U with a rule beneath it.

icons.name: chart-bar
icons.meaning: Comparing amounts: three bars of different heights sharing a baseline, not in rising order.
icons.label: icons.chartBar

icons.name: chart-line
icons.meaning: A change over time: a line with two bends above a baseline.
icons.label: icons.chartLine

icons.name: chart-pie
icons.meaning: Parts of a whole: a circle with one slice pulled out.
icons.label: icons.chartPie

icons.name: database
icons.meaning: A store of data: a cylinder in two sections.
icons.label: icons.database

icons.name: table
icons.meaning: A table: a landscape frame with a header rule, a row rule and a column.
icons.label: icons.table

icons.name: table-column-add
icons.meaning: Add a column: the frame with column rules and a small plus.

icons.name: table-column-remove
icons.meaning: Delete a column: the frame with column rules and a small minus.

icons.name: table-merge
icons.meaning: Merge cells: two arrows from the frame sides meeting where the column breaks.

icons.name: table-row-add
icons.meaning: Add a row: the frame with row rules and a small plus.

icons.name: table-row-remove
icons.meaning: Delete a row: the frame with row rules and a small minus.

icons.name: table-split
icons.meaning: Split a cell: two arrows from a whole column out to the frame sides.

icons.name: archive
icons.meaning: Stored for keeping: a box with a lid and a label slot.
icons.label: icons.archive

icons.name: attachment

icons.name: certificate

icons.name: home

icons.meaning: Higher education: a graduation cap.

icons.name: ambulance
icons.meaning: An ambulance: a box van seen from the side with a roof beacon and a pulse band along the side; no cross.
icons.label: icons.ambulance

icons.name: police
icons.meaning: The police: a patrol car seen from the side with a roof light bar; no badge, star, insignia or text.
icons.label: icons.police

icons.name: firetruck
icons.meaning: The fire brigade: a fire engine seen from the side with a ladder.
icons.label: icons.firetruck

icons.name: tram
icons.meaning: A tram: a tram seen from the front with its overhead wire.
icons.label: icons.tram

icons.name: subway
icons.meaning: An underground railway: a train in a tunnel mouth; no letter signs.
icons.label: icons.subway

icons.name: government
icons.meaning: The state, as opposed to the municipality: a building with a pediment and columns.
icons.label: icons.government

icons.name: wheelchair
icons.meaning: A wheelchair as an object, not a person in it: a big wheel, a back with a push handle, a seat, a footrest and a small front wheel.
icons.label: icons.wheelchair

icons.name: gender-male
icons.meaning: Male: the standard circle with an arrow out to the upper right.

icons.name: gender-female
icons.meaning: Female: the standard circle with a cross below it.

icons.name: gender-non-binary
icons.meaning: Non-binary: a ring with a stem up to the centre of a small cross made of two 45 degree strokes.

icons.name: gender-fluid
icons.meaning: Gender fluid: a circle with a male arrow and a female cross joined.

icons.name: tag
icons.meaning: A tag or label attached to something: a tag with a hole.

icons.name: hashtag
icons.meaning: A hashtag topic: two vertical and two horizontal strokes crossing.

icons.name: direct-message
icons.meaning: A private message to one person: a speech bubble with a single figure.

icons.name: pin-remove
icons.meaning: Remove a place or point: the pin with the badge minus.

icons.name: cash
icons.meaning: Cash: a banknote with a ring in the middle; no currency symbol or numeral.
icons.label: icons.cash

icons.name: wallet
icons.meaning: A wallet: a folded billfold with a clasp; not a card.
icons.label: icons.wallet

icons.name: theatre
icons.meaning: A theatre or stage: a stage with a scalloped pelmet, tied-back curtains and a floor line.
icons.label: icons.theatre

icons.name: translate
icons.meaning: Translate text from one language to another: two overlapping panels with a one-way arrow beneath, from the back panel to the front one; no glyphs.

icons.name: view-columns
icons.meaning: Show as columns: a frame divided by vertical rules.

icons.name: skip-next
icons.meaning: Skip to the next item in media: a play triangle against a bar.

icons.name: skip-previous
icons.meaning: Back to the previous item in media: a play triangle against a bar, the mirror of skip-next.

icons.name: person-remove
icons.meaning: Remove a person: the person with the badge minus.

icons.name: calendar-remove
icons.meaning: Remove a date or cancel a booking: the calendar with the badge minus.

icons.name: document-add
icons.meaning: Add a document: the document with the badge plus; no text line.

icons.name: document-remove
icons.meaning: Remove a document: the document with the badge minus; no text line.

icons.name: folder-add
icons.meaning: Add a folder or open a case: the folder with the badge plus.

icons.name: folder-remove
icons.meaning: Remove a folder or case: the folder with the badge minus.

icons.name: mail-add
icons.meaning: Subscribe by email: the envelope with the badge plus.

icons.name: mail-remove
icons.meaning: Unsubscribe from email: the envelope with the badge minus.

icons.name: mail-off
icons.meaning: Email is off or unavailable: the envelope with the kit slash.

icons.name: video-call-off
icons.meaning: Video is off: the video camera with the kit slash.

icons.name: mobile-off
icons.meaning: The mobile phone is off or unavailable: the phone with the kit slash.

icons.name: image-add
icons.meaning: Add an image: the image frame with its peak and the badge plus; no sun.

icons.name: image-remove
icons.meaning: Remove an image: the image frame with its peak and the badge minus; no sun.

icons.name: attachment-remove
icons.meaning: Remove an attachment: the paper clip with the badge minus.

icons.name: zoom-in
icons.meaning: Zoom in, show closer: a magnifying glass with a plus inside.

icons.name: zoom-out
icons.meaning: Zoom out, show more of the whole: a magnifying glass with a minus inside.

icons.name: expand
icons.meaning: Open one section: a chevron pointing down inside a square, the single-item counterpart of expand-all.

icons.name: collapse
icons.meaning: Close one section: a chevron pointing up inside a square, the single-item counterpart of collapse-all.

icons.name: pin-off
icons.meaning: A place or point is hidden or unpinned: the pin with the kit slash, its outline broken around the slash and its hole dropped.

icons.name: sort-ascending
icons.meaning: Sorted ascending, smallest first: the sort family's up arrow beside three bars that grow from top to bottom.

icons.name: sort-descending
icons.meaning: Sorted descending, largest first: the sort family's down arrow beside three bars that shrink from top to bottom.

icons.name: filter-off
icons.meaning: Clear the filters, or no filter applied: the funnel shifted 2 up, opened on its inline-end side, with the badge cross.

icons.name: attachment-add
icons.meaning: Add an attachment: the paper clip with the badge plus.

icons.name: hang-up
icons.meaning: End a call: the telephone handset laid down, ear and mouth pieces turned down.

icons.name: chat-off
icons.meaning: Chat is off or unavailable: the speech bubble with the kit slash.

icons.name: save
icons.meaning: Save your work or a draft: a diskette with a shutter and a label.

icons.name: heart
icons.meaning: Mark something as a favourite: an outline heart, two round lobes and a point.

icons.name: star
icons.meaning: A rating or a highlighted item: an outline five-pointed star.

icons.name: bookmark
icons.meaning: Keep a page or item to come back to later: a bookmark ribbon with a notched end.

icons.name: like
icons.meaning: Like or find helpful: a raised thumb with a cuff, no page behind it. A hand gesture, rude in some cultures; always with words.

icons.name: x
icons.meaning: The mark of the X social network (formerly Twitter): a simplified letter X drawn as a hollow slanted band crossed by a thin stroke that passes behind it, in one stroke. A trademark of its owner; always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text. Not a close or remove icon: that is `close`.

icons.name: facebook
icons.meaning: The mark of the Facebook social network: a simplified lower-case f inside a circle, its stem running down into the circle's bottom edge, in one stroke. A trademark of its owner; always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text.

icons.name: instagram
icons.meaning: The mark of the Instagram photo network: a simplified camera outline, a rounded square with a ring in the centre and a dot at the upper end corner, in one stroke. A trademark of its owner; always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text.

icons.name: linkedin
icons.meaning: The mark of the LinkedIn professional network: a simplified lower-case "in" inside a rounded square, in one stroke. A trademark of its owner; always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text.

icons.name: youtube
icons.meaning: The mark of the YouTube video network: a simplified wide rounded frame with a play triangle inside, in one stroke. A trademark of its owner; always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text.

icons.name: tiktok
icons.meaning: The mark of the TikTok video network: a simplified outline of a thick musical note with a hollow head and a hooked flag. A trademark of its owner; always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text.

icons.name: mastodon
icons.meaning: The mark of the Mastodon social network: a simplified speech bubble with a lower lip on the left and the network's m inside. A trademark of its owner; always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text.

icons.name: bluesky
icons.meaning: The mark of the Bluesky social network: a simplified butterfly outline in one stroke. A trademark of its owner; always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text.

icons.name: rss
icons.meaning: A web feed (RSS or Atom) to subscribe to: a dot with two quarter arcs spreading from it.
icons.label: icons.rss
